notes.title: DEMO version
notes.notes:
A demo version of the game is finally available! It includes a selection of tutorials from the full game and a set of unique puzzles that do not appear in the main game. The demo offers only a limited glimpse of the full experience, as advanced puzzles remain locked, and the design ensures a spoiler-free experience.
